title: How Master Chief was taken at age six in Halo
subject: masterchief
description:
Would you have survived the Spartan program? 👇

How a six-year-old boy from Eridanus II became John-117, the Master Chief of Halo. Spoilers for Halo lore.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Halo Studios, Xbox Game Studios or Microsoft. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: He was six years old when a stranger chose him.
In 2517, Dr. Catherine Halsey came to Elysium City on Eridanus II.
Her last test was a coin toss. John caught it mid-air and called the side.
That year, he and 74 other children were taken and replaced with clones that later died.
On Reach, Chief Petty Officer Franklin Mendez trained them for eight years.
At fourteen came the augmentations. Thirty of the children died, and twelve were left disabled.
John walked out unscathed. Halsey later called him quite possibly the luckiest of them all.
